dct_description_sm: This qualitative data set was generated as part of a Master of Arts thesis chapter. Focusing on the geopolitical and economic dimensions of mining on Svalbard, this data was developed with the intention to: - Understand the historical development of mining on Svalbard; - Analyse the historical and contemporary geopolitical motives for mining on Svalbard; - Evaluate the ways in which mining on Svalbard acted as a platform for other economic enterprises; - Better theorize contemporary resource development projects in the Arctic.
